description: §19.16.6 (S430 round 4, N2) — `first` (declared after the defer, called before it) calls `second`, another function declared after the defer. With the per-block stack nothing moves, so both are hoisted within the block: n2() = "21", trace "e;" — identical to the no-defer twin. (The round-3 lowering counted `second` as a tail binding, kept `first` inside the try, and threw `first is not a function`.)
rationale: §19.16.6: every declaration stays in its original block; function hoisting is unchanged by the defer.
